title: Cross-DKG Link Collection
description: Canonical, content-addressed collection of authority-neutral cross-DKG provenance links.
x-non-equivalences: collection membership does not qualify evidence
collection does not transfer authority between DKGs
collection digest is not a digital signature
x-canonicalization: links are ordered by deterministic source/target graph, record, relation and digest fields; DKG inventories are lexicographically ordered
